notes.title: PATCH 1.4 - THE SLASHER
notes.notes:
NEW ENEMY: SLASHER
A new enemy is on the prowl. Beware, they like to get up close and personal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/ad681e987b851199775a67005680a2dd783c95ca.jpg

ELEMENT GUIDE
One of the top requests from new players has been to add a way to reference the element descriptions outside of skill selection. An elemental guide has now been added to the in-game menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/11e10cb01fc089b0f0dcac6d2d3b3532ac4774a7.jpg

ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Reduced the brightness of lens flares. While shiny metal and flare are part of the overall aesthetic, some flares were too bright and distracting.

 The Journey Home: Per player feedback, adjusted the random distribution of flux events. Enough flux events to allow an augment before the 2nd world boss is now guaranteed.

 Light Rail: Reduced charge up damage and effect multipliers by 18%, and base damage by 4%.
 Focused Light: Reduced strong light base damage from 180-450 to 160-400.
 Noxious Plume: Reduced decay amount applied by 25%. Invulnerable time reduced from .4 seconds to .25 seconds.

 Nether Pull: Updated void jump to only allow only one active damaging void orb at a time. No more spam casting!


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Lightning Strike: Fixed issue which was preventing Lightning Strike damage after channeling for the required time.
 Frozen Cloud: Fixed the attack rate upgrade not applying correctly.
 Multiplayer: Fixed bug which could cause client players to see themselves standing upright after falling to their death.
 Ability Summary: Fixed flux damage and effect upgrades which were displaying half-transparent.

And many more smaller fixes, tweaks, and performance enhancements.

[hr][/hr]
1.4.0B HOTFIX

 Fix for some of the new text not translating.

[hr][/hr]
Calling all Challenge Mode players! Please consider enabling sending game stats under Game Settings. This helps us make informed balance decisions for players pushing The Black Pool to its limits.

Shout out to ThatPlatypus and Volcris for their world-first successful completion of a level 12 challenge run!

If you would like to be part of the community, join The Black Pool Discord.

notes.title: PATCH 1.3 - SPEED AND PERFORMANCE
notes.notes:
PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS

The Black Pool patch 1.3 brings many performance improvements. Following the last big content patch, we devoted substantial time to evaluate and tune both CPU and GPU performance. A large focus of this effort was to ensure that biomes which were less performant were brought into parity with the rest of the game. Most notably, the forest environment has been optimized and greatly improved, and now has a low-end tree replacement system for players on low foliage settings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/90775d197056867b4262515e6f1df22f3fbf391a.jpg

QUICK WIND REVAMPED

Wind Blast has been reworked to be more fun and useful from the start. The wind projectile now moves at a constant blistering speed, a 225% increase. The projectile speed upgrade has been replaced with an upgrade to increase the blast splash radius—a more rewarding option. Some additional adjustments were made to reduce accidental self knockbacks when hitting targets in close proximity. The attack rate upgrade and other attack rate modifiers now also reduce the time to maximum charge for the Gale Force augment.

NEW LOOK FOR THE DEVICE

The Device has been updated to help visually differentiate each of the device powers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/313e4192ab58045814cc01d967a8c89de307189f.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Player movement speed is now 20% faster, improving agility and feel while reducing run time in large levels.
 Reworked the light overcharge upgrade mechanic to now increase the charged damage and light effect without increasing overall charge time. Rebalanced the quick and strong attacks that make use of this upgrade.
 Updated fire and ice clones to not collide with players. No more deflecting off your friend’s clone when they cast it after hitting a jump pad! 
 Some of the longer levels have been tightened up to reduce excessive running.
 Added first-time shader compiling notification to the main menu to inform players when additional resources are being spent on compiling shaders.
 Additional refinement of movement animations.


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Magnus Underlord bosses: Replaced the penetrating laser with a bolt attack. Now all Underlord attacks can be blocked by the side pillars, fixing the issue of being hit through walls.
 Phantom Leap: Updated to have slightly more upward momentum and 20% more base height. Reduced decay jump height upgrade by 20%. Reduced invulnerability time upgrade by 50%.
 Decreased the move speed drop bonus from 50% to 40% to account for the new increased player movement speed.
 Adjustments to the Time Trial challenge mode timings.
 Boulder Toss: Increased base damage by 20%.


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Event Bars: Fixed the boss name listing twice in event bars while playing The Journey Home.
 Rallies: Fixed issues that could delay applying the effects of rallies, most impactful with Holy Light where it could be possible to cast and die without getting revived.
 Time Trial: Fixed display bug that could cause the time trial bar to erroneously show an extra minute in the countdown, giving the appearance of skipping time when it self-corrected.
 Stomper Boss: Fixed lag spike that could occur upon boss death.

Note: Recent NVIDIA drivers introduced a bug with DLSS which causes severe graphical glitching. If you experience this issue, updating your drivers or switching to TSR resolution scaling should fix the issue.

A huge shout out to BeardedInk and itsAlexxGaming for their extensive testing and feedback on performance for their setups! If you would like to be part of the community and share your opinion on what should be developed next, join The Black Pool Discord!

notes.title: PATCH 1.2 - ARENA SURVIVORS
notes.notes:
NEW GAME MODE: ARENA SURVIVORS

The Black Pool patch 1.2 introduces an entirely new game mode: Arena Survivors— a fast and intense battle arena featuring rapid progression and randomized waves of increasingly more difficult enemies. It delivers a fun and highly replayable “survivors-like” spin on The Black Pool gameplay, and also provides a quick way to experiment with abilities and builds without the time commitment of a full playthrough. A successful Arena Survivors attempt will take around 30 minutes, compared to 90 minutes for the full game mode (now called The Journey Home). 

[previewyoutube=0-QjYRkLS2w;full][/previewyoutube]
Four unique arenas have been developed for Arena Survivors, each presenting varied and evolving layouts, hazards, and challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/d7f5fc01e24cdecc73ecc673edf0e28588847c53.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/df5efc32d3a36a65100c8f7345d7fbf1c8905bc2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/bb4746a052fe97ebb5cb5042a06260f01da192c5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/a984d5ebeebad1f9b74adbe40ced94694d9820c6.png

ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Endless Mode: Upon clearing level 30 in Arena Survivors, players can choose to keep playing endlessly. Attempt to set new records, go crazy with augments, and push the game beyond its design constraints. Caps on the number of upgrades are increased. Things can get nuts. You have been warned!
 New dynamic music track: Making Contact. The musical score now consists of 7 dynamic tracks which seamlessly progress with the playthrough sequence, and 10 Temple tracks.
 Players can now reallocate their geodes in The Device, enabling more experimentation and strategy.
 Improved Widescreen Support: Dynamic FOV is now applied based on resolution aspect ratio, providing better support for ultra widescreen formats.
 When a player reconnects, the player will now respawn using a friend’s location rather than the level start.


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Added Rank 7 Enemies: Introduced an additional level of difficulty with a new top rank, Rank 7 (red). Rank 6 enemies, which were previously red, are now orange. Rank 7 enemies can appear in challenge modes, endless mode, and when playing in large parties.
 Detonating enemies now take 4 seconds to arm after spawning. If they are destroyed prior to arming, they will not explode for AOE damage. This greatly improves the experience of kamikazes and seamines spawning in close proximity to players.
 Stomper: Reduced the rate that player damage is applied when touching a Stomper laser plane.
 Infected Enemies: The orange area attack from flux infected enemies now fires less frequently.
 Ice effect on Bosses: Frozen status duration on bosses reduced to 50% compared to regular enemies (previously was 33%), but the boss now gains a half second immunity to freezing afterwards.
 Lightning effect on Bosses: Stun duration reduced to 50% on bosses compared to regular enemies.
 Ice Mine: Increased base damage by 20%.


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Improved AI: Enemies now have improved pathing when there are obstacles between them and players.
 Performance: Fixed a few memory leaks which caused longer levels to degrade in performance over time.
 Multiplayer: More robust channeled ability management, improving situations where ability duration is shorter than ping, which previously could leave a cast stuck channeling or prematurely end it.
 Fixed an issue that could cause event bars to stop being displayed.
 Seeker: Fixed multiplayer bug that could result in client players gaining infinite instant cooldown quick void attacks.
 Boulder Toss: Fixed issue where the boulder was not always colliding with enemies once redirected by an ability.
 Focused Light: Fixed "way too bright" visual bug.
 Fixed auto targeting point on wall turrets (for stone turrets and auto targeting spells).
 Fixed an issue when defeating the final boss which failed to trigger the end music queue and halt passive enemy spawns.
 Heals applied to shielded players will no longer trigger an “armor blocked” sound, causing players to wonder if the heal was reduced.

Plus many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes. 

1.2.0C HOTFIX

 Fix for Dynamic FOV.

1.2.0D HOTFIX

 Fix for issue with endless mode not being enabled on subsequent successes in a single session. 

1.2.0E HOTFIX

 Fixed Stomper Boss from having no cooldown at wave 60+ on the cluster bombardment. Also updated cluster bombardment to deactivate when it's source is killed, preventing taking damage way after killing the enemy.
 Tweaked arenas to eliminate "safe spots" out side the arena that some of the more entrepreneurial players have been exploiting.
 Prevent the endless mode from ending if players manage to get all possible upgrades.


[hr][/hr]


Shoutout to Volcris, ThatPlatypus, RedSpekkio, Skelly, Wrusty, DoomSayer, Sh4ft, and Morris230 for their help in testing this patch.

Creating a full new game mode was a huge undertaking. Let us know your thoughts and experiences on Arena Survivors! 

Endless mode was one of the top requested new features in our latest Discord player survey. If you would like to be part of the community and share your opinion on what should be developed next, join The Black Pool Discord!

 Added a new photosensitive mode in Settings that reduces flashes and suppresses HDR bloom and lens flares.

 Vipers now have a more aggressive attack pattern, and targeting laser visuals and sounds have been updated to better communicate the surface to air missile attack.

 Fire Clone: Fixed issue with the clone applying damage twice.
 Incinerate: Fixed issue preventing redirecting Terra boulders.

 Fixed issue preventing Entity statues from receiving continual ticks of damage from area spells.

Plus many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes.

1.1.0E HOTFIX

 Tangled Reach: Fixed issue that would reapply chaos global upgrades with each tick, resulting in insane chaos link damage. Also, updated Tangled Reach to not apply chaos to invulnerable enemies. (Thanks FR0STB1T)

 Molten Pillars, Upsilon Sector: Fixed a respawn point that could trap the player inside of rocks. (Thanks Chi_GGPB)

1.1.0F HOTFIX

 Fix for Chaos quick attack upgrades that could cause bounce damage reduction % bonus to be much larger than intended. Also fixed issue that could cause sprouts to excessively reduce their damage.


[hr][/hr]

The majority of features introduced in this patch were suggested by players in The Black Pool Discord channel. If you would like to be part of the community and share your opinion on what should be developed next, join our Discord!

notes.title: PATCH 1.0 - THE BLACK POOL GOES GOLD!
notes.notes:
This patch we focused primarily on polish and smaller bug fixes in preparation for officially launching The Black Pool on Steam!
It has been a long road to get here.  Thank you to everyone who has supported the game to help us reach this huge milestone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/c99292d11f9b7ea3ec725b89f969b92dd5e1ba34.png

FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Following completion of World 4, the new music track Suit Up now plays while players select their kill bonus. New lighting effects in the Temple have also been added.
 Numerous Temple updates have been made to improve overall polish, including the addition of twelve new murals. 
 The Device: When hovering over a Tier Up button, the new stat values for the next tier are now previewed and highlighted.

[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Flux that falls into a respawn zone is now awarded automatically instead of being lost into the abyss.
 Increased responsiveness of quick attacks. Quick attacks are now effectively fired on the very next frame following player input.
 Player input is now locked out while the level is fading in to prevent accidental inputs.
 When taking flux jump pads, air control is now locked out for a few seconds, preventing the player from accidentally holding a direction and failing to land on the flux event platform.
 Updated high rank bonus attacks to not trigger while the enemy is stunned.
 Icelands: Updated some keepers to spawn closer.


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Some video cards were getting a stutter the very first time a spell was loaded. This patch adds a shader pre-caching process that fires in the background when starting the game. This is a very manual process, so if you still find something that causes a stutter the first time it loads in combat, please let us know.
 Adventurous players have found ways to bypass spawns, which could prevent upgrades from appearing unless they ran back to trigger what they missed. This patch, a new system has been added to prevent these scenarios. If for some reason you ever get stuck, please report it.
 Fixed issue where DLSS frame generation could toggle on and off, causing unnecessary frame dips.
 Fixed issue where a non-valid resolution could be chosen when starting the game for the very first time.
 Gloom: Adjustments to low and medium quality settings to improve visibility and more closely match high quality settings.
 Fixed issue where server and client could desync when power ups drop to the ground.
 Multiplayer: Fixed spawn laser from beaming the incorrect direction on clients.
 Boulder Toss Multiplayer: Fixed client still seeing a boulder over their head for a few seconds if they abort a boulder toss by casting another attack.
 Fixed issue where the chat window could fail to scroll to the most recent message.
 Achievements: Addressed issue with Steam not accepting some unlocked achievements. Now on startup, the game will check Steam, and reattempt any achievements that are out of sync.

Plus many more smaller polish items and bug fixes. 

Special thanks to Pandize, Bayden, Daze Draco, itsAlex, BeardedInk, and Morgodin for their suggestions and bug reports for this patch.

[hr][/hr]
1.0.1 HOTFIXES


 Underlord Hive Boss: Fix to prevent rare scenario where the last two underlords could get stuck in a loop casting invulnerability on eachother. (Thanks GIT-R-DONE-PAPA)
 Stone Turret: Updated collisions, preventing player from potentially getting stuck in the turret. (Thanks BeardedInk)
 Multiplayer: Fixed Lightning Strike having 2 visible bolts strike down on clients.


[hr][/hr]
PLEASE HELP US GET THE WORD OUT ABOUT THE GAME! 

We are just a two person team, so even small mentions can really make a difference. 
Sharing our launch trailer on social media would help immensely!

[previewyoutube=jroKdnAte5A;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/5e643daa2ec3a888ae3afe57c064e59c6b145e3b.jpg

 New level (Gloom - Upsilon Sector)

 New details added in the final Forest level.

 Various audio improvements.

 Fireball: Reduced self amplified damage amount by 20%. Updated size growth to reflect how much extra damage will be done (grows larger with damage from friends).
 Updraft: Reduced based wind jump shaft uplift power by 16%.
 Blink: Reduced base lightning blink dash distance by 20%.

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.1 - A MORE POWERFUL DEVICE
notes.notes:
NEW MAGNUS LEVEL
This patch introduces Magnus - Beta Sector, which holds some fun surprises and unique challenges.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/06ea58c014e144536aa9c5d231e5884ca52deb4f.jpg

NEW DEVICE CHOICES
Two new unlockable slots have been added to The Device. In addition, the STEEL OR GLASS and STRATEGIC DAMAGE slots were each given a 3rd option.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/fe50b560a480d682b64d7c90560458873c0279ec.jpg

ELEMENT UNLOCKING
New players and new player slots now unlock 5 of the 8 known elements in a randomized order.  This introduces elements and new abilities gradually, and provides an improved sense of progression and discovery for new players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/1853325e4c81d944cc80bcb7d2df0d2c354a21ac.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Quitting the game: There is now, officially, the option to quit and save progress from the start of the current level. Alternatively, you can abandon the run.
 Magnus - Alpha Sector: Fixed large lag spikes that could occur during platform raising and lowering.
 Updated visuals for player effect cards, making them easier to read. Added visual effect cards for all drop effects.  Even instant effects display cards for a few seconds, providing clarity to what each drop does.
 Added visual effect to hands when the cast rate is temporarily boosted.
 Various audio improvements.
 Improved random music track selection to ensure that the tracks played at the end of the prior run are not immediately selected for a new run.
 Resuming runs now keeps the same music track selection for the resumed world.
 Some revisions to the Hammerhead and Overlord boss sequences.
 Added additional challenge mode achievements.
 Added support for resolution ratios narrower than 16:9.
 The Black Pool is now available in Spanish! If you would like to help with the game being available in your native language, please reach out on our discord!


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Updated instant cooldown effects to also refresh channeling pools.
 Shocking Current: Increased base channel time from 4 to 6 seconds, increased the full regen time from 12 to 14 seconds.
 Cross The Streams: Increased the time it takes to full charge up from 2 to 3 seconds.
 Updated to the “Friends dash on team kill” device option to give an instant cooldown on the NEXT dash, rather than only giving an instant cooldown on dash if it was currently on cooldown.
 Icelands Boss (The Spire): Added divider walls to make hopping between buttons more challenging.
 Updated so multiple “one time use damage increase” drops stack together to amplify the next spell, rather than being used 1 at time with subsequent attacks.


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Updated player turrets to not be targeted by player auto targeting abilities.
 Tornado: Disconnected the tornado’s rotational pitch from the player's aim.
 Islands: Improved visibility within clouds and brightness at night.
 Fixed the in-game menu ping display a client sees for the host.
 Fixed issue that would cause an Underlord to freeze up when being released from the Overlord.
 Blink: Fixed issue with having a different upward trajectory based on the direction the player is facing. Also, reduced its cast lockout time for other abilities, allowing quicker combos.
 Multiplayer: Fixed possibility of Rock Shot spawning below the desired hand location on client. We never were able to reproduce this. Please let us know if you see this happen again.
 Fixed issue where Shield Gen would try and shield a recently killed enemy.
 Multiplayer: Fixed Cross The Streams visual display glitching that could happen for clients.
 Intro Sequence: Fixed display issue on low settings where the camera which is seen sitting on a log would instead be seen floating in the air. Also fixed camera focus issues.
 Fixed issue with master volume slider where the audio level would not properly reset after setting to 0.
 Fixed issue where volume was being double applied when starting up the game.


Many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes.

Special thanks to aeamek for finding many of these bugs!

Post-patch fix: Corrected an issue with the new abandoning of a run that could result in not returning to the main menu.

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: PATCH 0.9.0 - NOW FEATURING 80 ABILITIES
notes.notes:
STRONG AND AREA ATTACK AUGMENTS
The Entity now offers augments for strong and area attacks! In total, this patch introduces 16 new augments, and 2 new base abilities.  There are now 80 unique abilities and augments in the game, ensuring endless build combinations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/37df12b7d27fe36a9cd1dc1895f67c1fae9fb7af.jpg

NEW HEAVY MECH: BEETLE

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/3986548cb3faf8051c390dc4f5c7058a4038c61a.jpg

NEW CHARACTER ANIMATIONS 
Improved character animations for Levitate, Grapple, Fire Thrust, and Nether Pull.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/06a8fb3f1ecf8e982d569cd8c54a175f21d4a372.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 The introductory text at the start of the game has been replaced with a short cinematic sequence.
 New Legendary Flux Event — It happens rarely, but it is very exciting when it does!
 Added a pair of destructible statues to the Temple that can be used for trying out abilities, and target practice.  The hitpoints of the two statues are constant, acting as a baseline of comparison within and across playthroughs.
 Two new levels (Maroon Fields and Obsidian).
 Improved the look of targeting decals.
 Added a target indicator for vulnerable projectiles and weapons, such as pulse disks, and the Shattered Crater boss missiles.
 Improved level selection to be more varied (while still randomized) across playthroughs.
 Various Temple visual improvements. Puddles now form below The Device when it rains.
 Player models are now automatically updated upon joining a multiplayer game with the same player model, preventing duplicates.
 Reworked element descriptions to be more concise, and easier to understand.



[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Replaced Stone Wall (Terra Area) with a new ability: Stone Turret. Stone Wall was just too limited in its usefulness.
 Replaced Boulder Toss (Terra Strong) with a new, easier to use ability: Rock Strikes. Boulder Toss, being a more advanced ability to execute, has had its damage increased, and is now offered as an augment to Rock Strikes.  Boulder redirects have also been made more predictable in certain situations.
 Reworked Hover (Terra Jump), and it has been renamed to: Levitate. Overall feeling and maneuverability has been improved, and a bug has been fixed which sometimes sent the player in a vertical trajectory.
 Removed the velocity requirement for dashing. If a standing player dashes, they will dash forward.
 Implemented diminishing returns to the effects for Fire, Decay and Void. Newly applied Fire will be reduced as the total damage per second reaches 300. Likewise, applied Decay and Void will diminish as they approach 300% amplification. 
 Flash, now renamed to Focused Light: Added a preview of the focused light beam while charging. Updated starting cone angle from 30 to 45, replaced max charge range upgrade with overcharge upgrade, added a 2X max range extension when fully charged, reduced max charge multiplier from 4 to 3.
 Lightning Effect: Rather than creating 0.1 second micro stuns, it now stuns for 0.4 seconds, making stuns more noticeable for non-strong lightning abilities.
 Lightning: Global upgrade changed from increasing stun time, to increasing lightning applied, resulting in more frequent stuns.
 Shocking Current: Replaced "Increase rate of fire" upgrade with "Increase channeling time".
 Arc Lightning: Replaced "Increase damage and effect" upgrade to “Increase damage”.
 Ice Shield: Reduced cooldown from 12 to 10 seconds, but cooldown now begins upon shield destruction.
 Ice Mine: Now detonates when arming if proximity was breached prior to arming.
 Crystallize: Max range increased by 66%.
 Incinerate: Reduced base fire amount from 17 to 15 dps.
 Radiate: Replaced upgrade that increased effect to instead increase damage.
 Tornado: Replaced upgrade that increased projectile speed to instead increase the tornado size.
 Mantis (Obsidian Boss): Scaled down boss attacks based on the world and number of players. Made the creeping energy ring slightly lower, resulting in it being easier to jump over.
 Pulse Disk Launcher: Slightly lowered pulse disk damage rings, making them a bit easier to jump over.
 Ball Drop Flux Event: Updated to scale less dramatically with player count.
 Defend Flux Event: Increased defend tower hit points against triwings.
 Elemental Rings: Increased attack range by 25%, increased damage by 200%. Updated attacks to not redirect boulders.
 Time Trial: Rebalanced target times for each level based on playthrough data.  Special thanks to those who have enabled sending game stats in the options menu!



[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Shattered Crater, Gamma Sector: Fixed a rare condition which could prevent upgrades from spawning, killing a run. (Sorry if you encountered this one!)
 Fixed issue where glitchy spikes could form in the black pool.
 Player collision meshes are also now vaporized in the portal, and will no longer block friends.
 Shattered Crater: Fixed a performance issue, resulting in a significant performance increase for some CPUs.
 Enemy Rank Challenge mode: Fixed issue with Skylands boss in where Spider spawns would continually get promoted to a higher and higher rank.
 Ice Platform Jump: Fixed a performance issue, resulting in a significant performance increase for some CPUs.
 Rallies: Updated to not land on enemies, which could cause the rally to be floating in the air when the enemy moved away. Fixed issue where aiming down while casting a rally on a flat surface could have it penetrate through the ground.
 Drops: Fixed display of stacking drop effects. For example, two movement speed buffs will now show +100% movement speed for the period when they overlap.
 Fire Thrust: Fixed issue where upward momentum would be lost when activated at certain times, such as when using a jump pad.
 Jagged Peaks: Fixed rare placement issues with Pyramid Missile launchers.
 Multiplayer: Fixed issue where clients could not see other players charging dashes or jumps.
 Multiplayer: Fixed issue where if a player entered the temple dead, they would not receive heals when revived.
 Multiplayer: Fixed issue where high rank hex blockers were double spawning for clients.
 Magnus boss: Fixed issue where all Underlords in the first stage could all focus fire at the same time.
 Skylands, Beta sector: Added an intermediate step where players could get caught, forcing them to backtrack.
 Moten Pillars: Fixed collision issue where it was possible for players to fall behind rock walls and get stuck.
 Moten Pillars, Gamma Sector: Fixed issue where Flux Ball Drop event could spawn partially outside the level boundary.
 Moten Pillars Boss: Updated top rotating platform to be easier to jump onto.


Many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes. 

This is a huge patch.  Check it out and let us know what you think of all the new updates!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: PATCH 0.8.2 - THREE ABILITIES TO START
notes.notes:
THREE ABILITIES TO START
Players now start with three abilities, choosing from each of the offered starting elements.  Previously, combat in the first world could feel limited with only two abilities. This makes the first levels feel more engaging from the start, and also requires players to improvise with their builds a little bit more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/8840edc3f3251e47eb8243e2f122b44264c63551.jpg

PATCHWORK
A point of frustration for players has been falling into crevices while in combat. We have painstakingly gone through all of the biomes and smoothed out many of these problem areas. While we want there to be environmental obstacles to contend with, the worst offenders have been greatly improved. If you run across an area that feels “bad”, let us know!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/c52d5b21a35d348dccce5c242ccdb9725420e4fe.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Player starting jump hang time has been reduced to feel a bit less “floaty”.
 Levels now have enemies spawned at the start, helping the worlds feel more populated.
 Improved out of combat spawns to be biased in the direction of progress and to not interrupt guide arrow display.
 Further revisions to the new player tutorial biome sequence.
 Respawn button: Added a visual effect to indicate that a respawn is in progress.
 Icelands Boss: Platforming revised to be a bit easier.
 Additional new and tweaked sound effects.
 Added informational popups for the more complicated abilities. If you feel a skill could use more explanation, please let us know.
 World and level numbers now display in the in-game menu.


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Single player revives on the Proficient difficulty now heal 100%.
 Kamikaze Mechs now have a distinctive footstep sound, making it easier to hear them coming.
 Jagged Peaks Pyramid missile barrages now scale based on player count and playthrough progress.
 Rift Storm: Improved to hit more frequently, hit enemies above, and have a larger radius.

[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Fixed issue that would prevent guiding arrows from showing on Jagged Peaks boss.
 Numerous fixes to guiding arrows on Temple, Icelands and Molten Pillars bosses.
 Performance tweaks for shield generators.
 Fixed Fire/Decay/Void amounts on the health bars to continue to grow when the logarithmic bar fills up.

Many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 0.8.1 - HEALTH BARS AND DROPS
notes.notes:
ENEMY HEALTH BARS
This patch, we have delivered one of our most requested features: enemy health bars.  In addition to displaying the rank and hit points for medium and heavy enemies, all currently applied elemental effects are now visualized as colored bars.  These bars provide greater clarity to elemental effects— how long they last, how much effect has been applied, and crucially, when the thresholds are about to be reached for time-limited effects such as frozen, blind, and brittle.  Relevant numbers are also displayed, such as total damage amplification from decay, or the current damage over time amount from fire.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/139663167510b3e186597ca351c73964dabbcd17.jpg

EVENT BARS
Bosses, flux events, and hold points now display event progress bars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/1303a6ca2d72fe51ad25d230d87e52a439bd1b09.jpg

ENEMY DROPS
Enemies now have a chance to drop short term power-ups on death. These power-ups include: increased movement speed, next attack does double damage, a shield that absorbs 50% damage, increased attack speed, instant cooldown for all abilities (except rally), and a close-range attack ring for every element.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/bfdd18f79c5c3b85e1cbed8e436bbec21d7ec520.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Two new levels (Skylands and Icelands, Upsilon Sectors)
 Damage numbers have been enlarged, and health bars and other UI elements have been updated to improve legibility.
 Updated visual effects for attacks from Jellyfish, Starfish, and flux parasites to be less visually dominating.
 Wyld Stallyns music sequence: reworked and expanded the 1st and 3rd levels.
 Added new challenge modes: Enemy Rank
 Temple shortcut now orients players towards the map room vortex and avoids stacking players. Apologies if you loved this feature. We did too.
 Molten Pillars Boss: Numerous updates and fixes to improve this boss encounter. Upper platforms are now easier to land on. Guidepoints have been added. Respawn points added to the top section, preventing players from having to re-do the platforming if they fall off. Lower platforms have been updated to prevent snagging, and they won’t shut down when the boss is defeated, avoiding a rare situation that can strand a player in multiplayer.
 Numerous performance enhancements.


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Added a short invulnerability window to players when respawning from a fall.
 Updated all elemental effects to last 5 → 6 seconds before falling off if not renewed.
 Fire Abilities have been adjusted to account for the increase in effect duration from 5 to 6 seconds. Fire Effect damage number ticks now display in orange instead of gray.
 Quick Fire and its augments now do 4X damage when hitting an enemy not already affected by fire. This improves fire versus light enemies, without breaking its already strong late game power.
 Several small tweaks to player movement to reduce the frequency of snags on the environment.
 Fireball: Greatly increased damage radius expansion when exploding, preventing situations where enemies may move out of range before being hit. Updated the visual effect to fizzle rather than explode when exceeding spell max range.
 Frenzy: Reduced base augment attack rate penalty from 25% to 15%.
 Implode: Reduced base damage by 15%.
 Shocking Current: Tripled damage.
 Lightning Strike: Reduced base damage penalty from 50% to 25%. Increased AOE radius of Lightning bolt strike.
 Radiate: Reduced base damage by 25%.
 Reburn: Updated to have its range extended before triggering a bounce back when increasing the projectile speed.
 Light Cleave: Reduced base damage by 10%.
 Underlord Boss: Increased hit points by 25%.
 Icelands Boss: Added invulnerability window after all generators are destroyed to shed all elemental effect stacks.
 Healing Challenge Modes: Increased heal reduction from 33% and 66% to 50% and 75%.
 Jagged Peaks Boss: Updated leg laser walls to now block “hitscan” spells like lightning and Incinerate.


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Obsidian Boss: Plasma wave attack now damages players again!
 Fixed issue where guiding arrows could break and stop displaying.
 Fixed a very rare issue that could cause a fatal error game crash.
 Magnus Underlord boss: Fixed AI possibly breaking when an Underlord is killed in the first stage.
 Fixed issue where Air Spawners could agro enemies and end up in a stuck AI state.
 Molten Pillars Omega Sector: Fixed potential issues with spawns / triggers / enemies preventing level completion. (Thanks to Timothy for the heads up.)
 Arc Lightning: Fixed issue where the attack was not visually arcing to hit targets.
 Fixed multiplayer issue where a rally cast could drop 2 rally banners.


Many more smaller tweaks and bug fixes. 

Try out the patch and let us know what you think of the new enemy health bars and power ups!

notes.title: SMALL FIX PATCH 0.8.0.1 - SOME UPDATES
notes.notes:
Fix for a rare multiplayer issue where a client could not see the offered elemental upgrade. This was a rather rare issue which was problematic to reproduce, so we could not 100% verify it has been fixed. Please let us know if you run into this issue after this patch!
 Light Fissure: Fix for not damaging stationary targets.
 Lingering Death: Reduced the damage/effect over time by 50%. Also fixed clouds redirecting Boulder Toss.
 Triple Shot: Reduced spread from 10 degrees to 7.5 degrees.
 Phantom Leap: Fix to prevent teleporting through walls above the player.
 Updated some stationary enemies to not slowly creep away when hit by wind force on clients in multiplayer.
 Audio will now remain active when the game window loses focus.

notes.title: PATCH 0.8.0 - INTRODUCING AUGMENTS
notes.notes:
QUICK ATTACK AUGMENTS
The Entity now offers augments for quick attacks. Unlike upgrades, augments completely alter abilities with new mechanics and effects. Each quick attack has 2 unique augments. Augments remain compatible with any upgrades you have selected. In total, this patch introduces 16 new abilities, bringing the number of quick attacks in the game from 8 to 24!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/f3b33bc89eac7faf7e296c8d2d3b897f4f5b8c73.jpg

HIGH RANK ENEMY ABILITIES
Rank 4 and 5 enemies are now randomly granted one of three additional abilities: hex shield, barrage, or laser blocker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/113071d05aff94b69d367c35f1c28d08a312e99a.jpg

TEMPLE DEVELOPMENT
The Temple courtyard has been further developed with new structures, details, and lore elements— with more to come.  Additionally, a new Temple music track “Onset” has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/d74df2da1a050542e19444d34c6515527dfcd80d.jpg

[hr][/hr]
ADDITIONAL FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Improved Mobility: By popular demand, the base dash, and all other dashes can now be activated in the air. This change improves early game mobility and dodging, and establishes consistent movement mechanics regardless of your build. Additionally, players now have 50% more directional control in the air.
 New random flux event: Defend. Defend the tower from destruction by the attacking swarm of enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/1aa55c2f6738b9b8ff0caf52893fb7fbe5e6672e.jpg
 With the addition of augments and multiple quick attacks per element, all abilities in the game have been uniquely named.
 Improved enemy agro management. Enemies are now more reactionary in changing targets based on damage and crowd control being applied. They will now even react to friendly fire and attack their fellow mechs if they are aggravated enough.
 Key bindings are now displayed next to abilities when in the in-game menu. There is a gameplay option to always display these keybinds.
 A revive prompt and key binding is now displayed when in range of a fallen friend.
 Ability Summary now includes flux elemental upgrades.
 Added graphics option to enable V-sync.
 In-game music tracks are now synchronized for all players. (Temple music is still random for each player.)


[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Breeze (Wind Dash): Added additional force when changing directions.
 Blink (Lightning Dash) and Phantom Leap (Decay Jump): Improved camera behavior with blink abilities to provide a better sense of direction, movement, and distance traveled.
 Blink (Lightning Dash): Added a 10% upward direction and updated logic so small rocks and obstacles do not obstruct the dash.  Added a bit of directional momentum after the blink.
 Updraft (Wind Jump): Wind shafts now summon in front of the player movement direction, making them more effective when moving laterally.
 Stomper Boss: Added invulnerability periods on stage changes to shed accumulated elemental stacks. Increased stage 2 and 3 health by 10%.
 Rift Slide (Void Dash): Orb now explodes in a blast area on collision.
 Engulf (Area Fire): Attack now lobs a projectile that explodes on impact, rather than projecting downward to create the fire area. Decreased fire effect by 15%.
 Radiate (Decay Area): Increased damage by 50%, common quality upgrades to effect increased 10% → 20%, updated orbs to start closer and rotate 25% faster.
 Increased Keeper HP by 12.5%.
 Updated The Entity to always offer an additional upgrade, and in single player, Revive. (If the player has already used their revive.)
 Decreased Rhino hitpoints by 20%.

[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES


 Fixed a memory/GPU leak related to ice spells that would substantially degrade performance over time.
 Fixed an extremely rare issue that may prevent a client player spawning on level transition, having to reconnect to the hosted game.
 Fixed issue where players were unable to chat at the end of an attempt.
 Fixed issue where the saved controller type of Playstation or Switch controller selection did not apply when launching the game.
 Final Overlord Boss: Made fixes where feet could penetrate deep into the ground. Made several performance enhancements, which should lead to a better framerate for this encounter.
 Fixed issue with Flash (Strong Light) that was allowing the charged attack to do 4X damage.
 Fixed issue issue with Light Blast (Area Light) that was causing it to increase damage when charged, in addition to AOE range.
 Fixed rare multiplayer issue where clients may not see a shield gen’s invulnerability laser targeting the correct enemy.
 Forest: Removed player collisions with fallen trees. Previously, players with low foliage settings would still collide with fallen trees that were invisible to them.


Countless more smaller tweaks and bug fixes. 

[hr][/hr]
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

This has been a massive patch to develop and release. With such a large amount of new skills being added, there will undoubtedly be additional skill balancing. Community feedback is our primary method for deciding what developments are to be worked on next. If there is something specific you are hoping for in future updates, please reach out and let us know!

notes.title: PATCH 0.7.2 - PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS & FIXES
notes.notes:
While we have been working hard on a large content patch for January with some very exciting new features, we have addressed several performance issues and fixed some outstanding bugs. We decided to gather those up to push in a patch now, rather than waiting a few more weeks for the big content patch.

BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS

 Skylands & The Forest performance improvements. Reworked the foliage system to be more performant and to better scale on medium and low settings. Some cards were really struggling with foliage (such as the 1660). This update should dramatically improve frame rates for these biomes. We don’t have access to all video cards to test on, so please, share if there are any areas that are performing poorly for you!
 Molten Pillars: Previously, at night, certain lighting conditions and combinations of shadow quality settings could be very dark.  These conditions have been made brighter.
 Fix for rare client player issue where the upgrade pads would not be visible. This was extremely rare and we could not reproduce it to confirm that this is 100% fixed, but the correction made *should* address the error. Please let us know if after this patch you cannot see the upgrade pads!
 Fixed issue where you could fail to cast while landing from a large fall.
 Previously, it was possible for strong and area light to get “locked out” on client players if they did a ‘no channel’ cast during a large latency shift. This is now fixed.
 Fixed issue where you couldn't charge/channel spells until going to the next level after being AFK for 10 minutes.
 Fixed issue where Jagged Peaks pyramid launcher could project its leg to a flux platform.
 Added missing guiding arrows on Jagged Peaks Omega Sector.
 Skylands: Updated grass to not grow through primary jumppads, upgrade pads, and portals. Fixed floating grass in some areas. Rearranged the upgrade pads on Omega Sector to be in-line like all others.
 Gloom Alpha Sector: Eliminated possibility of accidentally missing a spawn, thus not triggering the upgrades until going back and finding the spawn
 A few other smaller fixes.


If you run into any issues, please let us know.  It’s the best way to ensure that the issue will be fixed so it doesn’t happen to you again!

notes.title: HOTFIX 0.7.1F - DECAY JUMP HOTFIX

notes.title: PATCH 0.7.1 - STOMPER HAS ENTERED THE CHAT

NEW BOSS: JAGGED PEAKS
A massive new boss has come to the Jagged Peaks. Every world now has its own unique boss, totaling 10 unique boss encounters in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/cddfc3160353bcba7ce2d4bf4a7052f488555c40.jpg

NEW ABILITY SUMMARY SCREEN
By popular demand, we have added an ability summary screen. Now at any time during the game, you can review the details of the abilities and upgrades you have selected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/64caae3c95a0ee69d0823335b28f13007dcdf129.jpg

DAMAGE NUMBERS REWORKED
The damage number display system has been completely reworked. Our goal was to increase legibility, while minimizing the visual impact and over stimulation of information.  Higher damage numbers are now displayed larger and for a longer duration, making them much easier to read while in combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/ee7a7130f5cb4690b5e8f79cb883ad710ce72e3b.jpg
[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Shortened light’s blind effect versus bosses, lasting ⅓ as long. Previously a fully upgraded blind effect could essentially blind-lock bosses.
 Strong light now scales up in damage when charged, in addition to the narrowing and lengthening of its beam.
 In time crunch mode, picking up flux now rewards an additional 15 seconds of time. Now if you complete flux events successfully, they will be worth the time spent.

[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Icelands boss rework: Previously, the boss could be cheated using penetrating skills and large AOEs. It has now been updated to make use of triggered floor buttons to trigger deactivating invulnerability pylons. In addition, it was difficult to tell what parts of the boss spire were to be targeted. Cosmetic updates were made to make it clear what is vulnerable and what is to be targeted.
 Sound improvements: Numerous sounds have been added and updated in this patch. This includes more audio impact for players hitting the ground, all new sounds for lightning attacks, an audio cue for all light abilities when max charge has been reached, sound for the activation of jump pads, and many others.
 Improved animation system: Players are able to jump and dash while channeling or charging abilities. This mechanic resulted in these casts persisting after the ability animations completed, appearing odd at times. A new animation persistence system has been developed to properly return to the ability casting/charging state after performing a maneuver.
 Fixed issue where Steam may not award an achievement when earned. Added new achievements for completing the relatively new Molten Pillars and Jagged Peaks biomes.
 Added a few more one time popup messages to explain essential game mechanics based on feedback and players streaming the game. If there is anything you found confusing that needs a better initial explanation, let us know! 
 Updated a few screens that were not working well with controller input.
 Player characters now animate appropriately when falling from great heights. (No falling damage was added)
 Fixed a client only issue where ability elements would not visually refresh when selecting an upgrade and having an additional upgrade from the flux entity.
 Magnus - Alpha Sector: Adjusted stage 3 platform movement so that if you are standing on the jump pad when it is activated, it will not send you into the gaseous abyss.
 Fixed a few enemies that would not have a “flash when hit” effect for client players.
 Many more minor bug fixes and improvements.


[hr][/hr]
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

If there is something specific you are hoping for in future updates, please reach out and let us know!

notes.title: PATCH 0.7.0 - NEW HORIZONS
notes.notes:
NEW BOSS: MOLTEN PILLARS
This patch we ambitiously developed our most involved boss encounter yet, introducing several new game mechanics. Additionally, two new Molten Pillars levels have been added along the outskirts of the boss structure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/4abf1382bdce5f84a331e7a22681ff1dd7c60ce9.jpg
NEW MOON: JAGGED PEAKS
This high elevation biome features five new levels, and is temporarily protected by the Beetle boss until Jagged Peaks gets its own boss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/4070cbecf57510f79014ab1f0f9345ec4fbdf3fa.jpg

[hr][/hr]

 Previously, the first few levels in a playthrough could feel a bit empty. There are now an increased number of enemies at early levels, but the enemies have been de-ranked, reducing their damage and hitpoints.
 Increased the frequency of common flux events, ensuring players have more opportunities to accrue flux within each world.

 Updated Void Area and Void Dash to not inadvertently redirect Strong Terra boulders.
 Quick Ice bounces now deal double damage in addition to double effect.
 Reduced force of the wind jump upgrade.
 Increased Keeper move speed by 10%.
 Reduced Colossus base hit points by 10%.
 Reduced decay dash effect by 50% and increased damage by 50%.
 Jellyfish and Snowflakes now spawn lower to the ground.

[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Skylands: Greatly improved performance in golden hour lighting conditions.
 Fixed broken Flux combat platforms where enemies could spawn and be unable to move, or spawn below the platform. Enemies knocked off of combat platforms will now self-destruct.
 Fixed multiplayer issue that could cause players to fail to load when returning to the Temple.
 Fixed issue in single player, where if you fell off the map while dying, you could lose your revive.
 Fixed a very rare issue where a player could get stuck in an infinite respawn loop.
 Fixed issue with multiplayer clients still seeing their Reroll button after using their Reroll.
 Fixed issue with multiplayer clients seeing the Overlord boss warping around away from its Underlord feet.

 Molten Pillars - Alpha Sector: Fixed issue where players could respawn underground in certain locations.
 Gloom - Beta Sector: Fixed Keepers that could spawn inside of holdpoint tower mesh.
 Maroon Fields Boss: Fixed issue where exit jump pad could activate before boss was defeated.
 Maroon Fields: Increased brightness in dark shadowy areas.
 Increased height of the dead body particle effect, making it easier to spot your fallen friends.
 For new players, the master volume will now default to 100%, and Gamma Boost will default to 40.
 Many more minor bug fixes and improvements.

This patch fixes the last two known rare but impactful issues that could cause a client player to have issues on map changes, requiring them to rejoin the game. Should you encounter any issues, please share them with us so we can get them fixed.

[hr][/hr]
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

Overall, the game is in a great shape in both single and multiplayer. Dive in with your friends and let us know what you think of the new patch!

notes.title: PATCH 0.6.0 - THE ENTITY HAS ARRIVED
notes.notes:
INTRODUCING FLUX
We have developed a new system that issues collectibles within a playthrough called Flux. Procedurally selected events occur throughout the playthrough to reward Flux. An alien being called The Entity spawns prior to bosses and offer rewards that can be redeemed with Flux. Initially, 3 common and 2 uncommon Flux event types have been developed. More events, as well as more rewards will be added in future patches. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/56bbada1503ccc95e63e5abf56baab5b063c314d.jpg
NEW MOON: MOLTEN PILLARS
Added the new Molten Pillars biome. Currently it is being protected by the Gloom boss, but it will get its own boss in the next patch. Likewise, more sectors will be added for greater variance in the next patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43171253/95d21c3ac9abe0dcdcf7f5e3bf73aeadc86c308d.jpg
[hr][/hr]
BALANCE UPDATES


 Quick Wind rework: The disk with a long cooldown has been replaced by a more rapid spear of air. With this update, wind force has been re-balanced.
 Mech friendly fire update: Mechs now do 5x damage to other mechs, making the damage that has been balanced for hurting players more impactful when hitting their fellow mechs.
 Keeper updates: Updated keeper spawns to not be as far away, and added more variance to potential spawn areas. Increased spawn and keeper sounds to make it more noticeable when it has entered the battlefield. Slowed the keeper by 12%, and increased the time before self-destruct by 1 second per rank. Updated keeper to be unaffected by wind, eliminating the concern in accidently knocking them off and not being able to get the reward. Improved reward placement logic, it should eliminate most issues where upgrades spawned on impossible to access cliff sides.
 Increased ice quick attack rate to be 15% faster.
 Doubled the damage of each void area rift hit.
 Reduced terra brittle damage amplification (+300% damage → +200%).
 Slight nerf to light jump, reduced base charge power by 5%, and upgrade power by 20% (still the highest jump in the game).
 Reduced fall damage from 20 to 15.
 Reduced HP of Triwings (150 →100 base HP) and Jellyfish (100 →60 base HP) and Kamikazes (100 →20 base HP).


[hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS


 Added an invulnerable flash when hitting parts of enemies that cannot be damaged. There were impressions from some players that the hit detection was not working when certain enemies were not taking damage. This should make it more clear what parts of enemies are vulnerable.
 Improved out of combat spawns location logic to ensure the enemy is reachable by the player.
 Magnus boss: Fixed glitch which could cause Underlords to get stuck targeting and do nothing. Also fixed a bug where the Underlord Hivemind would focus entirely on just one player.
 Fixed visual glitchiness of mechs being hit by wind alongside a cliff edge.
 Enhanced temple return shortcut opening sounds/lighting. This should help notify new players and prevent needless full runs to the vortex within a playthrough.
 Fixed bug not allowing chatting after jumping into the temple vortex.
 Dozens of other minor performance tweaks, enhancements, and fixes. 


[hr][/hr]
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK

Overall, this is our largest patch to date! Please share any feedback you have for this patch on our Discord or on the Steam Patch thread!

notes.title: PATCH 0.5.1 - VOID
notes.notes:
New elemental elemental school: Void. This includes 6 new abilities with 11 new upgrades. A video highlighting the new abilities can be viewed here:
[previewyoutube=xuc7nWi8bX0;full][/previewyoutube]
 New enemy: Viper. Locks on and sends missiles at players flying through the air, if you see a blue tracking laser, get to the ground!
 New enemy: Jellyfish. A minor threat, but can do damage if in clusters or they go ignored.
 Magnus in the sky. When entering the map room you are shown the moons you visit all orbit around a large gas giant planet. Visual updates have been made so this gas giant will be visible in the sky of these moons on clear days.
 Updated enemy AI to track ice dash clones. While enemies targeted ice clones, they still had their movement track the player. They will now make pathing decisions based on the ice clone (e.g. no more kamikazes running after the player while an ice clone is up).
 Double jump abilities were only triggering after jumping. They have been updated so they can be triggered while in the air, no matter how the player got there (e.g. falling off an ledge).
 Wind jump shafts will be slightly angled in direction of the player's velocity, making them more useful while on the move.
 Strong Terra updates: Now prevents secondary toss until the rock is fully formed, inherits the caster's velocity when tossed, and had its base damage increased by 20%.
 Strong Ice updates: Updated max shield absorbed damage 300→600, max damage 350→750. Replaced the increased effect upgrade with one that increases damage absorbed by the shield (allowing it to charge up to full faster).
 Added a lighting effect to highlight friends in multiplayer. This should make it easier to see your allies without adding an obtrusive UI element.
 Device procs would display twice on multi-part spells (e.g. when casting quick wind and when quick wind bursts). All spells have been updated to ensure the proc will trigger only once, making it clear when the proc evaluation is being done.
 New cross reticle option added.
 Improved rally casting to prevent scenarios where the cast was to an invalid area or was interrupted, thus forfeiting the cast for the entire world.
 Several improvements to spell and ability descriptions.
 Many more smaller tweaks, fixes, and enhancements.

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 0.5.0F
notes.notes:
Low graphics settings updates to make the forest biome look much better without shadows.
 Fixed a few respawn points where the player may get stuck in the ground when respawning.
 Added a few additional respawn points to various levels.
 Increased spawning invulnerability time, giving slower loading players time before taking damage if other players start combat without them.
 Updated visuals for rally spell banners.

 Added temple visual updates to device hallways and make return trip shortcuts more obvious.
 Many other smaller tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 0.5.0E
notes.notes:
New lighting for the Gloom Biome on medium and low settings. It was wayyy too dark if you did not have volumetric fog + global illumination. It should be far better to play on now.
 Small rework of quick decay to make it more distinctive and easier to use as a new player. It will attack faster, but do less damage and effect.
 Updated passive/active spawn logic to only account for the number of living players. The existing logic was making it near impossible to recover if a few players in the party die.
 Added additional logic to attempt to spawn keeper upgrades if location is over a cliff-side.
 Updated wind jump shafts to negate falling speed quicker, allowing them to be effective when used when falling.
 Increased Magnus Underlords HP by 33%.
 Death notifications are back!

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 0.5.0D
notes.notes:
Updated player base run speed to be 10% faster.
 Updated players to do 30% more damage on easy.
 Shortened the following maps to make them more consistent with other levels: Gloom Beta and Gamma sectors, Maroon Fields Beta Sector.
 Updates to Icelands Beta sector to make the jumping sequence optional.
 Updated so hosting/singleplayer will now default to the last difficulty played, if none have been played it will default to easier.
 Added prompt to run suggested settings benchmark on brand new game installs. Made tweaks to  suggested settings thresholds.

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 0.5.0C
notes.notes:
Added a fix for the rare "client loads new map and can't move" issue.
 Added fix for when falling to death with an auto-revive being active, triggering the revive before the respawn from falling has occurred.
 Added logic to prevent far away enemies preventing upgrade selection.
 Updated maroon fields boss to only spawn rank 1 snowflakes, regardless of the bosses rank.

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 0.5.0B
notes.notes:
Fixed respawn on Icelands that could get a player stuck
 Fixed bug with lighting attacks that would continue to damage prior hit enemies, while continuing to channel, but not no longer hitting them.
 Increased Magnus bosses' health by 1/3rd
 Fixed Obsidian boss pathing updates to *hopefully* prevent terrain clipping deaths.
 Updated portal spawning condition to only verify living players have upgrades. This will prevent a run from getting stuck in the rare scenario a player is dead and is not in a spot that can be revived.
 Fixed 'guiding arrows' current binding from not populating in options menu.

notes.title: PATCH 0.5.0 - EARLY ACCESS GOLD BUILD
notes.notes:
New Gloom map added.
 Increased difficulty of multiplayer spawns (modified by number of players). Playthroughs were still easier with having more players in an attempt, this gets it much closer to being in balance.
 Heavy game size optimizations - After this patch, the game should take up 1/3 less harddrive space.
 Updated boss levels to offer 3 possible elements to upgrade.
 Overhaul of sound and music balance and dynamic range.
 Added new "getting started" video
 Fixed issue where player skin could be semi-transparent.
 Mech AI updates to Scorpion, Javelin, and Colossus - Added agro swap logic to make them more of a threat in multiplayer.
 Mech Javelin and Colossus - Added chance to swap target after a reload is triggered, mech gets quick reload when changing targets.
 Updated device option 'dash and damage' (3s → 2.5s, 25% → 20%)
 Update device option combo (100% → 50%)
 Many more smaller fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.8
notes.notes:
These few patches leading up to Early Access release has really focused on performance, bug fixes, and adding polish. Once past the initial EA launch, we will go back to more substantial updates, adding more abilities, biomes, enemies, etc.


 Added 16 new achievements.
 Many, many performance updates. Hosting a game will now have a lower CPU demand.
 Skylands boss updated to have a more consistent attack pattern.
 Reworked Maroon Fields lighting to be more performant.
 Fixed rare 'failing to connect issue' when changing levels.
 Added frame limit option in the graphics options.
 Added credits screen - If you are a Beta tester, this is your last chance to give feedback to be listed in the credits.
 Removed "in combat" safety-net preventing selection of upgrades in combat when in challenge "time crunch" runs.
 Increased temple heal range so it can't be missed.
 Added quick way up to the temple map room corridor, making it easy to get up if you fall off.
 Fixed issue that could cause the very first name change and player selection to not save in a new save file.
 Fixed issue with shield gen that could cause it to spawn below the ground.
 Nerfed move-speed perk after kill to do 5% boost per level, leaving room for a secondary speed increase.
 Updated keeper, last patch's update to make him scale with player count made him too tough in multiplayer - Decreased base HP (400 → 350), and extended self destruct time (12 → 14s).
 Nerfed quick fire base effect (45 → 40).
 Nerfed area fire, reduced radius by 12%, reduced effect by (50 → 40), increased range it will "project down" when bursting in the air.
 Nerfed strong decay (base damage 25 → 20, base effect 100 → 50)
 Many, many other small tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.7
notes.notes:
Added new fly mech. We were getting feedback that gnats were too cruel early on, and punished players getting "slower" quick attacks in the first world. The fly mech is a fatter, slower, and less threatening mech than the gnat. It will replace gnats in the first world played, and some of the second world.
 New music track sequence for The Forest, all worlds now have music!
 Many performance updates, focusing on ensuring combat is smooth as possible.
 Added gibbing of enemies that are destroyed with overwhelming force.
 Reworked strong terra to be a two part cast. First step, will hold above your head, a second cast releases it in a toss like before. Teammates can shoot it out of your hands while holding it, or redirect it after it has been tossed.
 Added bindable key to toggle tunning on guiding arrows.
 Challenge Mode: Fixed the healing entity from being used more than once (in heal challenge runs).
 Challenge mode: Updated time crunch to stopped damage ticking when exiting a level, the timer will still run until the last player exits the zone.
 Updated keeper hit-points to scale with # of players, reduced base HP 500 -> 400.
 Set default music to 50%, now that we have music for the entire playthrough. If you have it off from when it was defaulted that way, try turning up the music and give it a listen!
 Updated multiplayer HP multipliers (2x, 3x, 4x to 2.2x, 3.4x, 4.6x). Multiplayer was a bit faster, and therefore easier than single player, this should help balance the difficulty difference.
 Fixed issue with Gloom and Skyland boss's spawns.
 Fixed overlord from prematurely self destructing.
 Fixed issue with sea mine mechs not adjusting their elevation on clients.
 Fixed issue when revived while using the free-cam, not triggering to go back to the standard player cam.
 Fixed temple possibility of blinking past planet selection trigger.
 Added a 5 second delay to the respawn button in the in-game-menu, so it can't be used to cheese falling.
 Additional temple music tracks added.
 Many more smaller tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Two new boss encounters - added to Icelands and shattered crater biomes. All worlds now have their own unqiue bosses.
 New biome music tracks for the Magnus word.
 Updated challenge mode "time crunch" timings.
 New world/level display when first entering them and when pulling up the pause menu.
 Additional controller development. Switch pro controller now supported (In steam options, need to turn on "Steam Input for Switch Pro controllers").
 Additional temple music tracks added.
 Wind knockback nerf - reduced base knockback by 25%. It was too easy to knock enemies off, now will require some more upgrades to get that level of knockback.
 Many smaller bug fixes, tweaks, and improvements.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.5
notes.notes:
Implemented 2 additional device slots, with 2 options each.
 Added new enemy: The Torcher.
 Added Steam achievement integration.
 New biome audio track added.
 Made some sizable performance updates.
 Additional controller input refinement.
 Casting resurrect has a 75% chance of drawing agro (only relevant in games with 3+ players).
 Reduced base brittle duration (3s → 2).
 Updated terra area base damage (10 → 15), updated upgrade that increases effect to now increase damage and effect, updated so pulse disk reflected damage hurts the disk launcher not the destroyed disk.
 Skill balance updates:
      • Increased decay jumps blink height by 20%.
      • Nerf to quick fire base effect (50 → 45)
      • Nerf to area fire fire tick effect (50 → 45)
      • Reduce effect quick quick decay (150 → 130)

 UI work on active effect cards to display next to the health bar.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Warning: This update will reset your key binds

 Added controller support.
    - Vord and I are mouse and keyboard players, if you are a controller player, please let us know how it feels!
    - If you have issues where you are unable to navigate the UI (Moving the dpad on the main menu is not highlighting buttons teal), please let us know.
 Added 4 new levels - one each for the Obsidian, Greink, Islands, and Icelands biomes.
 Added visual/audio notification when device enhancements proc (3 spell combo, dash combo, in air cast, damage full HP enemy).
    - sound/visuals are subject to change, we just wanted to get a notification system in place.
 Implemented new "Glass" option from the device that should be worth considering taking over "Steel" - "Increases damage by X, increases damage taken by 25%".
 Enabled heal based challenge mode.
 Added new audio track to the random biome rotation.
 Many other smaller tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Finished arrow guidance option
     - Will now prompt if you want guiding arrows when starting a playthrough, with option not to ask in the future.
     - Guidance configured for all levels, you can temporarily turn this on if you get lost in the forest.
     - Only a small amount of players will use this, but beta testers, it would be great if you could do a playthrough or two with it on to provide feedback on it!
 Fixed issue where Islands boss would plumet to its death when hit by wind effect.
 Fixed issue with Overlord boss that could cause him to self destruct.
 Fixed issue that was periodically causing a hard crash on level transition.
 Magnus updates
     - Updated lowering floor sequences to make it way more obvious that you need to get off the platform ASAP.
     - Boss canopy charges up for longer and now has a very distinctive charge up sound.
     - Boss canopy pulse updated so it is brighter when closer to the camera, making it easier to judge depth to dodge.
 Buffed strong wind - Made the tornado wider thus easier to hit, and results in more hits before passing through.
 Buffed area decay - Made rotating columns wider, thus easier to hit enemies, avoiding scenarios where the prior rotation was too close and the next one was too far.
 Updated stats to only count applied damage (now ignores overkill damage).
 Casting revive interrupts any held casts *cough strong ice abuse*.
 Set challenge mode time goals based on stats, thanks to those who turned on sharing stats!
 Many other smaller fixes/tweaks.

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Added ability to recover an noncompleted run. If you crash, when starting back up, the game will now offer the option to resume your attempt. If it was multiplayer, other players can re-connect once the host resumes the attempt. This should make the random directx12 crash that is beyond our control, way less painful.
 Improved client reconnecting for when a client player crashes or disconnects.
 Added out-of-combat passive spawn system, where enemies will spawn when out-of-combat for a short amount of time. This is part of an effort to remove boring downtime runing between some spawns, share your thoughts on how this feels!
 Added new Sea Mine Enemy.
 Added new metalace level.
 Connected music. There are only 2 level tracks added so far, so you will likely want to turn off music after a few worlds. But please, listen and let us know if you hear any issues. (Is a dynamic music system, not just a music track player).
 Added arrow guidance option that will show the direction to advance through the level. This is still under development and has some issues. For now, they only shows on the temple and a few levels. It can be turned off in the gameplay settings.
 Added a few safeguards to prevent being held up from progressing to the next level. Let us know if you find a scenario where you can't advance!
 More sound effects added.
 Many smaller fixes, tweaks and performance updates.
